messages:
jamal: quick sanity check — I ran `terraform plan` for the overlay that wires secrets from SSM -> SecretsManager for staging. Plan shows a serviceAccountRoleBinding change for `svc-app-staging` and a secret rename. holding before apply. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 :eyes:

maria: looking now. can you paste the plan snippet?

jamal: paste below:
```
# module.k8s_overlay.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.app_binding will be updated in-place
~ resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "app_binding" {
    role       = "svc-app-staging"
    policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
}
# module.secrets.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.app_secret will be replaced
-/+ resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "app_secret" {
    secret_id     = "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456789012:secret:app/staging/config" -> (known after apply)
    secret_string = jsonencode({"DB_PASSWORD" = (sensitive)})
}
```

alex.k: two quick clarifying Qs: 1) is this a path rename or duplication? 2) will the pods pick up the new secret name automatically or do we need a rollout?

tara: it's a rename (we're moving from `/ssm/app/staging` -> `secretsmanager:app/staging/config`) so consumers will see a new secret ARN. pods referencing the k8s secret will need restart unless we mount env via CSI that updates automatically. I think our overlay also updates the k8s Secret data, so a rollout will be triggered if we update the secret resource in k8s.

maria: confirming — TF change includes `kubernetes_secret` data update in overlay-staging. plan shows `replacement` for the aws_secretsmanager_secret_version which will cause secretsmanager version rotate but the k8s secret resource gets new `string_data` hash so deployment will see change.

jamal: ok. risk: there are two statefulsets: `db-migrator` and `worker`. we should avoid simultaneous restart for both. propose canary: update worker first, watch latency, then promote. anyone object if I do canary apply limited to `module.k8s_overlay.module.worker`?

alex.k: sounds good. add a rollout-liveness-check in the canary run — maybe run `kubectl rollout status -n staging deploy/worker --timeout=120s` and smoke test.

tara: also need to handle secret aliasing for rollback: if something fails we want old secret still available. jamal, add `aws_secretsmanager_secret` tag/alias so we can point back quickly.

jamal: will add alias step in PR and hold on full apply. doing a local targeted apply for worker only: `terraform apply -target=module.k8s_overlay.module.worker` after I push alias change.

infra-bot: reminder: staging changes > 20 resources require runbook and at least one approver from eng-sre. See <https://redwood-internal/runbooks/overlay-promote>. :information_source:

maria: thanks infra-bot. jamal — pinging @sre_oncall for quick approve when ready.

sre_oncall: ack, I'll review the plan in ~15m. if you can DM the smoke test steps I'll run them during canary. :+1:

jamal: smoke steps: 1) curl /health on worker behind staging gateway 5x 200s, 2) run migration dry-run (script in repo) `scripts/check-migration.sh --env staging`, 3) verify queue backlog stays < 50 for 10m. i'll post results here.

alex.k: FYI also updated the PR with a small kube manifest tweak to add annotation `redwood.com/secret-rotation: \"true\"` so we can track rotated secrets. nothing blocking.

tara: looks good. once canary passes we should schedule promote window for low-traffic (01:00-03:00 UTC). posting to calendar now.

jamal: thanks all — I'll incorporate alias, push a revised plan, and hold the apply until @sre_oncall gives green. tagging `#eng-oncall` for awareness. :wave:
